dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings across the mid-lateral section; features thin dark perimeters with a rapid gradient transition to higher intensity interior pixels, particularly visible in the central-left quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid dark irregular nodes interspersed between the annuli, primarily concentrated in the anterior dorsal region and lower ventral-lateral transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct macro-annuli in the mid-body form an obtuse scalene triangle with the longest side oriented longitudinally toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of overlapping, smaller circular motifs is visible along the dorsal ridge near the mid-section transition.
